titles.romaji: Benghuai: Xingqiong Tiedao - Ni... Nihao, Wo Jiao Huohuo
titles.english: Honkai: Star Rail — H-Hello, I'm Huohuo.
titles.native: 崩坏：星穹铁道 你…你好，我叫藿藿

description:
"H—Hello, I'm Huohuo, the newly appointed judge of the Ten-Lords Commission. Um... what else should I mention.."
"Ahem... Uh, Hello? Don't forget to introduce the most famous heliobus of all..."
"Ah, yes — Tail! This is Tail!"

(Source: Honkai Star Rail YouTube Channel)
